# Suwappu API

> Repository-local pointer. The canonical machine-readable index is generated from the same GitBook source that powers https://suwappu.bot/docs.

## Canonical machine docs

- Website docs index: https://suwappu.bot/llms.txt
- Website full docs corpus: https://suwappu.bot/llms-full.txt
- API-surface discovery index (separate runtime catalog): https://api.suwappu.bot/llms.txt
- Human docs: https://suwappu.bot/docs
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://api.suwappu.bot/v1/agent/openapi
- A2A agent card: https://api.suwappu.bot/.well-known/agent.json
- MCP: POST https://api.suwappu.bot/mcp

## Authority boundaries

- REST/SDK: full Agent API. `POST /swap/execute` is managed-wallet signing/broadcast; `POST /swap` is unsigned self-custody preparation.
- MCP: source `0.6.0` advertises 22 tools. Historical tool name `execute_swap` only prepares an unsigned self-custody transaction; it never signs/broadcasts or creates a managed swap record. Discover the current catalog with `tools/list`.
- A2A: quote, price, and discovery intent layer. It does not execute trades.
- HyperLiquid Agent API: market discovery, indicative position quotes, and position reads only. It does not expose perps open/close execution today.

## SDK versions

Repository source currently targets `@suwappu/sdk` `0.6.x` and Python `suwappu` `0.3.x`. Package registries can lag source; verify the installed version and fall back to REST/OpenAPI when a package is not yet published.

Do not copy API details from this pointer into a long-lived client. Fetch the canonical generated files above so tool counts, docs pages, and examples stay synchronized with the deployed documentation.
